notes.title: Seeking Dawn Patch Content
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

Today's small patch is fixing curent issues with Multiplayer matchmaking. We fixed an issue where the EU and NA servers were not accessible and an issue where they were displaying waiting instead of the real ping between players and server. Players can now play with each others even using different game platforms. We are sorry for these issues as well as having you updating the game again. 

Thank you for your support and if you have any question or issue with Seeking Dawn don't hesitate to join us on [b]Discord: https://discord.gg/xud47Y9[/b]

notes.title: Update changelog 2019-11-14
notes.content:
Seeking Dawn Valve Index Integration Update!


After many requests, pleas, and tears from some VR players. Our Valve Index integration update is ready! As many players have been asking for this update for some time, we have spent hours coding, testing and working with our loyal followers, in order to ensure that the update works for our title "Seeking Dawn".


We hope to continually add content, optimize our game and improve the overall experience for our players around the globe. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us on our various platforms.

notes.title: The "Master Mode" is on!
notes.content:
We are really excited to finally release[b] the Version 2.0 of Seeking Dawn[/b]. Lots of fixes and optimizations have been done.
We also added a lot of new content, including a brand new mode "Master Mode" with a weapon levelling system, level difficulty adjustments and balances, and newly unlocked areas.
I hope you will enjoy it and stay tuned on our official social media! Localisations are going to be released little by little, starting from next month! Please leave comments on our social media to tell us which language you want to see added to Seeking Dawn!

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MultiverseVR
Twitter: https://twitter.com/VRmultiverse
Discord: https://discordapp.com/invite/p3jvJnq

------2018/11/20 - Changelog------

Added a new storehouse
Added a new campaign mode with a weapon levelling system
Added difficulty settings
Added a special reward for beta players
Added a new area in The Frozen Hollow
Added a new buff/debuff feature 
Added some new achievements
Added split backpack resources feature 
Added area resources collection feature
Added mechanical version of several enemies

Improvements and changes:
Saving the game will now save player position
Changed several areas (The Mount Omen, The Depthless Lair and The Frozen Hollow)
A more living and complete ecosystem
Display more details on the saving slot UI
Rendering optimisation

Fixed several bugs or other errors

notes.title: 2018/08/30 - Seeking Dawn Update Log
notes.content:
Bug fixes：
Fixed an asset loading issue where non-romanized characters in a file path caused the game to get stuck on the main menu
Fixed a bug where you could activate the shield while climbing
Fixed a bug where you could damage yourself in multiplayer while shooting close to your hands
Fixed a bug where Oculus users would not hear anything in the Oculus headset
Fixed a bug where the player orientation after teleporting in blink mode would be different from the hologram model's orientation
Fixed a bug where firing the shotgun while having the hand close to the head would open the quick mission interface because of recoil
Fixed a bug where a drop pod door would not close in multiplayer if someone left the game before entering it
Fixed a bug where Locilus corpses would still move after dying
Fixed several network issues
Fixed several other errors


Improvements and changes:
Added a backpack function to only drop a portion of an item stack
Added a left-hand control scheme
Added achievements on Oculus Store version
Added the room code inside of the settings menu
Added more information in the save slot interface
Added camera rotation controls to the joystick of the Windows MR controller
Added the option for Vive controllers to move while either touching or pressing the trackpad
Added respawning to collectible resources
Changed remote players' damage checks to be local for more realistic combat
Changed the firing mechanism of the Spitting Cobra
Changed forest lighting to make it brighter
Optimized several sudden framerate drop issues 
Optimized networking
Optimized rendering and particle effects
Optimized logic calculations
Optimized environments
Balanced enemy and weapons stats
Updated the localization

notes.title: 2018/08/06 -Seeking Dawn Update Log
notes.content:
Bug fixes：

Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck after having the crafting table destroyed by another player；

Fixed a bug where the backpack would not open during the tutorial if the settings menu was opened and quit without applying new values in the main menu；

Changed the thirst and hunger notification time interval；
Changed the "you've left the playable area" notification；
Added an option to disable the "you've left the playable area" notification;

Improved the weapons angle on the Vive;
Added an explanation in the quest interface when a quest is waiting for another one to proceed;
Balanced Trogleuth and weapons stats;
Updated the localization;

notes.title: Fixes And Update Plans!
notes.content:
Since yesterday’s launch of Seeking Dawn, we have received tons of constructive feedback, suggestions and good wishes from our passionate community. 

There are also technical issues and bug reports that we value equally. We'd like to take the time to thank each and every one of you for using your precious time to provide us with important information so we can continue to improve Seeking Dawn.

Our mission to develop one of the best VR games is not yet finished. But thanks to your undying support, we are more encouraged than ever before.

We sincerely apologize to every player who is having technical issues at the moment. We have located several issues that require immediate attention, such as crashes, stutters, and blurry graphics. Our dev team is working night and day to fix these issues.

Also, we are making some adjustments to gameplay mechanics to make Seeking Dawn even more fun!

We will release a more detailed roadmap along with plans for new content soon. Stay tuned for some exciting announcements!

In the mean time, feel free to follow us on social media and our Steam community. As we work to continue to enhance your gaming experience, please continue to send us your candid feedback, that’s what helps us improve.
